techniques.name: Solvent Welding (Dichloromethane)
techniques.safety_notes: ADVANCED USERS ONLY: Dichloromethane is acutely toxic — causes chemical burns, is a suspected carcinogen, and can be fatal in poorly ventilated spaces. Full-face respirator with organic vapor cartridge, chemical-resistant gloves, and outdoor or fume-hood ventilation are mandatory.

techniques.name: IPA Vapor Smoothing
tools_needed: wire rack or hook to suspend part
techniques.safety_notes: IPA vapor is flammable — no open flames or sparks. Work in a well-ventilated area or fume hood. Wear nitrile gloves and a respirator. Do not heat the IPA to accelerate the process — fire risk.

techniques.name: Manual IPA Brushing
techniques.safety_notes: Wear nitrile gloves. Work in a ventilated area. IPA evaporates quickly but is flammable.

techniques.name: Flame Polishing
techniques.safety_notes: Work in ventilated area. PP melts quickly — do not hold flame in one spot. Keep heat gun moving. PP combustion produces irritating fumes.

techniques.name: Mechanical Sanding
techniques.safety_notes: Standard dust precautions. Replace sandpaper frequently as PP residue loads the grit quickly.

techniques.name: PP-Compatible Adhesive Bonding
techniques.safety_notes: Primer contains adhesion promoter chemicals — ventilated area, nitrile gloves.

techniques.name: Sanding
techniques.safety_notes: Wet sand and wear a mask. Dust from high-performance polymers should not be inhaled, and dry sanding generates a lot of it.

techniques.name: Annealing
techniques.safety_notes: Use an oven rated for the temperature and never a domestic food oven. Ventilate; ramping and cooling slowly matters more than hitting an exact soak temperature.

techniques.name: Drilling and tapping
techniques.safety_notes: Eye protection. Do not let the drill heat the part above its service temperature; smearing indicates too much heat.

techniques.name: Bonding and inserts
techniques.safety_notes: Ventilate while mixing epoxy. Insert installation temperatures for this family are much higher than for commodity plastics; use a tip that can reach them.

paintability.recommended_primer: standard plastic primer; this polymer takes paint readily
paintability.notes: The easiest dissipative grade to finish. The whole caution is electrical — coatings insulate, and this is also the material most likely to be used for a cosmetic part where someone paints it without thinking.
